svg.text: Data Flow Diagram — Coach Drill Designer
1. Next.js renders page → Client component mounts → Zustand persist rehydrates from localStorage automatically
2. seedIfEmpty() called → if no drills exist, seeds 3 sample drills + 2 sessions + 1 team from src/lib/seed.ts
3. SSR-safe adapter: checks typeof window !== 'undefined' before accessing localStorage — prevents hydration mismatch
ArrowObject.startPlayerId / endPlayerId → PlayerObject — live position tracking on canvas
